|---|---|

| **updated** | on every `build_kit.py` run |
| Purpose | Before any file exists, say who opens this, what it is called, what it must show tomorrow for it to have worked, what goes wrong and who keeps it. |

## Questions

| id | question | required for | optional | v1 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| P1 | Who opens this, and what are they trying to get done? | page, chat, link | no | yes |
| P2 | Say it in one line someone else would understand. What should it be called? | page, chat, link | no | yes |
| P3 | You open it tomorrow. What do you see that tells you it worked? | page, chat, link | no | yes |
| P4 | Walk me through using it once, start to finish. | page, chat | no | prefilled |
| P5 | What is the worst wrong thing it could show, what should it show instead, and what do you do then? | page, chat, link | no | yes |
| P6 | Who fixes it when it breaks, and what date should it be looked at again? | page, chat, link | no | prefilled |
| P7 | Is anyone besides you going to use this? | - | yes | end |

## Rules

| id | rule | kinds | Sutra source | enforced by |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| PR-1 | One line names the app in words the reader already has; it becomes name (80) and tagline (140). | page, chat, link | schemas/app-manifest.schema.json name/tagline; modules_api.py NAME_MAX/TAGLINE_MAX | server truncation; C3 |
| PR-2 | Success is something you can see on open, and it is the app's done check. 'It works', 'done', 'no errors' are refused. | page, chat, link | sutra-defaults.json trivial-verify blocklist; 2026-09-11-apps-prd.md | C2 |
| PR-3 | The failure answer names what is seen and what to do. A denial is not an answer. | page, chat, link | ADR-020 PRD shape | C2 |
| PR-4 | The kind follows the job: a thing to look at is a page, a conversation is a chat, a shortcut to a screen is a link. The kind is chosen in the New control before the session opens. | page, chat, link | 2026-09-08-modules-design.md D-M2; app-manifest.schema.json kind enum | create_module validation; the New picker |
| PR-5 | Every app names an owner and a review date. Archiving is the end state and never deletes. | page, chat, link | APPS-LIFECYCLE.md | C7 |
| PR-6 | A page and a chat stay draft until the success line is true. A link is created ready because its whole surface is one server-validated screen id. | page, chat | modules_api.py create_module status; mark_ready | mark_ready 409 on must-fix failures |
| PR-7 | 'Just me' to P7 suppresses positioning, pricing, growth and competitor questions entirely. They are never asked by default. | page, chat, link | FOUNDER-DIRECTIONS.md D75 ruling 4; writing-style P0 MINIMIZE | question set; C24 and C31 promote only when P7 names someone else |
| PR-8 | The builder reads plain words. The thing is an app. No block names, decision ids or status lines anywhere a person reads. | page, chat, link | FOUNDER-DIRECTIONS.md D75 ruling 4; APPS-DESIGN.md | C4 (single home of the rule) |
| PR-9 | One app, one job. The Founding Doctrine Simple test applied to an app; the other four tests are platform properties. | page, chat, link | root-os/FOUNDING-DOCTRINE.md five tests; D75 ruling 1 | C5 (advisory) |

## Checks

| id | level | kinds | v1 | what | evaluator |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| C1 | required | page, chat, link | must-fix | APP.md exists at the folder root and every row id required for this kind carries a non-empty answer. | parse the APP.md tables into {row_id: answer}; assert the profile's required ids are present and non-empty; 'not recorded' (imported) is WARN not FAIL |
| C2 | required | page, chat, link | suggest | The P3 and P5 answers are real answers, not slogans or denials. | shared NT(cell): not in the trivial-verify blocklist, at least 5 words, P5 not matching ^(none|nothing|n/a|it can't|won't happen) |
| C3 | required | page, chat, link | must-fix | name and tagline are present, within caps, different from each other, and the tagline is the P2 answer. | len(name) <= 80, len(tagline) <= 140, both non-empty, name != tagline case-insensitively, normalized tagline equals or is contained in the P2 cell |
| C4 | required | page, chat, link | must-fix | No founder-only text anywhere a person reads, and the app is never called a module. | pattern scan over APP.md, name, tagline, surface.instructions and index.html text: block prefixes (INPUT:, TYPE:, ROUTE:, DEPTH:, TASK:, TRIAGE:, OS:), +-- FLOW/BLUEPRINT/DISPATCH, ATOM:, BUILD-LAYER, ROUTING PIN, dref-, ADR-nnn, D-Mnn/Dnn, and 'module' outside module.json, /api/modules, ~/.sutra-ui/modules |
| C5 | advisory | page, chat, link | suggest | One app, one job. | WARN when P1 contains ' and also ', ' as well as ', ';' or more than two sentences |
